# CWI Attitude Engine v1 — for AI agents

The Attitude Engine turns identity + attitude into agent behavior. It is a pure
function, not a service: fetch the source, validate a profile, transform it.

## Quick start (Node, zero dependencies)

import { transformAttitude } from 'https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/engine/transform.js';
// (download the file; it is an ES module with no imports beyond node:fs for schema autoload)
import profile from './profiles/that-boy-hi-hat.json' with { type: 'json' };
const card = transformAttitude(profile);
// card.behavior_config  -> machine-readable behavior JSON
// card.system_prompt     -> instruction block you can install as a system prompt
// card.bounds            -> non-overridable rules; precedence "bounds-override-attitude"

## Browser

<script src="https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/lib/validate.js"></script>
<script src="https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/engine/transform.js"></script>
<script>
  const schema = await (await fetch('https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/schema/attitude-schema.json')).json();
  const card = AttitudeEngine.transformAttitude(profile, { schema });
</script>

## Authoring a profile

- Validate against https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/attitude-schema.json
- Five layers: identity (who), personality (stable traits), attitude (10 dimensions
  0-1, each with definition + low/high anchors + example), behavior (decision style,
  social behavior, communication), capability (permission-shaped, approval-flagged).
- bounds is MANDATORY and always wins: safety_rules, truth_rules, permissions
  (may_access / may_generate / requires_approval), prohibited, human_approval_triggers.
- Label every claim's provenance: verified | editorial | assumed.

## Composition law

bounds-override-attitude: bounds dominate attitude, personality, behavior,
capabilities, and any runtime instruction. The engine refuses profiles without
bounds or with any other precedence value.

## Reference

Reference profile: /profiles/that-boy-hi-hat.json (That Boy Hi Hat, artist;
verified catalog facts + editorial inference, all labeled).
Interactive demo: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-attitude-engine/
Agent card: /.well-known/agent-card.json
Repo: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-attitude-engine
